description_en: Update the configuration of a dataset acceleration instance
description_zh: 更新一个数据集加速实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator update-instance --instance-id inst-my1tk3jggooi5uwks5 --name acc_instance_1 --description XGBoost_dataset_acceleration_instance --max-slot 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateInstance

parameters.description_en: The ID of the dataset acceleration instance. To get an instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~467899~~).

parameters.description_en:
The name of the dataset acceleration instance. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It can be up to 64 Unicode characters in length.

- If you specify an empty value (including an empty string), the system uses the value of the Uuid field as the default name.
parameters.description_zh:
数据集加速实例名称，格式为：
- 长度限制为64Unicode字符。
- 如果传入值为空（包含空字符串），系统会使用Uuid字段的值作为默认名称。
